subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers supersede the open external fork closing reference and allow a fresh narrow fix for this Debug Snapshots UX bug, or continue trying to adopt that fork path?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but live issue metadata still has an open external closing pull request reference, so automation should not create a duplicate fix until maintainers choose the route.

options.title: Supersede fork path
options.body: Close or ignore the external fork closing reference as non-viable for this repository and allow a fresh narrow OpenClaw fix to proceed.

options.title: Adopt fork path
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor turn the fork work into a current, reviewable OpenClaw pull request before queueing any replacement.

options.title: Keep waiting
options.body: Leave the issue open with no new fix PR until the external fork author updates or abandons the work.

recommendation.title: Supersede fork path
recommendation.body: Close or ignore the external fork closing reference as non-viable for this repository and allow a fresh narrow OpenClaw fix to proceed.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest original Debug dashboard ownership signal and is the best available owner for deciding the Control UI fix path.
